item.title: AIM movers: Safestay sells London hostel property and The Property Franchise Group continues growth path
item.summary: ECR Minerals (LON: ECR) says underground development at the Maddens underground mine in Queensland has identified an additional mineralised quartz vein containing visible gold. There is investment in processing equipment that will improve gold recoveries when production commences ECR has a 50% interest in the Maddens gold project. The share price gained 10.8% to 0.205p.
